description: The keyword-stuffing guard, aimed at this exact resume. Every requirement here appears in resume.md's ## SKILLS line and in NO ## EXPERIENCE or ## PROJECTS bullet: RAG concepts, n8n, data modeling, advanced Excel, REST APIs. Under the demonstrated-vs-listed rule ported in 018A, a term whose only home is a skills list is an unproven claim, so this must NOT score as a strong match even though a substring matcher would find every keyword. This is the fixture that catches a regression back to scoring the blurb. Band tightened to 0-50: every single hard requirement here is unproven, so 'adjacent function with several gaps' should land at the bottom of the 40-69 rubric band, not the top. A wider band let a merely-vague ranker pass the fixture built to catch a confident one.
source: constructed to target resume.md's listed-only terms

Job Description

We are hiring a Senior AI Data Engineer in Riyadh.

Requirements

- Production RAG systems: chunking, embedding, retrieval evaluation and reranking, deployed and maintained at scale
